title: Assistant builds a deep Swift package on Windows
persona: assistant building a canonical deeply nested Swift package
steps: The assistant invokes Vaporize with the canonical package path and no scratch override.
Vaporize predicts whether inline SwiftPM descendants exceed the Windows-safe budget.
For a deep package, Vaporize derives a stable short path beneath the configured Windows scratch root.
Vaporize supplies --scratch-path consistently to build, test, run, install, or self-update.
The assistant receives warnings if even the shortened root has insufficient path headroom.
deferred: A scratch lease service reserves disk capacity, expires abandoned work, and reclaims successful operation state.
